useWhen: Assess repository maturity from the owner collector and its measured corpus; use when deciding one actionable repository improvement.
avoidWhen: Automatic score editing, broad forest maintenance or runtime qualification

outputs.finding: one measured gap with collector receipt

authority.binding: caller authorization and owner-reviewed target repository policy

compatibilityNote: Hermes storage format only; wildcard versions do not establish installation or runtime qualification. Bind source dependencies and effective permissions in the owning repository.
